title: Train
suits: logistics, shipping, travel, mobility, supply chain and delivery: products that move things from A to B, told with warmth rather than dashboards

params.--field: the sky; hills, ground, sun and steam are tinted from it
params.--brand: the train and the mark's enamel plate
params.__MARK__: stroke paths in a 24 x 24 box, set on the brake van's enamel plate in --on-brand
params.__WORD__: one flatcar per character up to 12, two per wagon beyond

details: a travel-poster dusk: layered hills, a low sun, telegraph poles and rails
a little steam train comes in from the left pulling one flatcar per letter and a brake van that carries the mark
it brakes with sparks at the wheels
the couplings bump in a ripple down the train as it stops
the mark and the letters lift off their wagons into the wordmark above
the whistle puffs a small cloud
the drivers slip once as it pulls away, then it chugs out to the right
steam puffs are sunlit on top and shaded underneath, tinted from the sky
the mark sits on an enamel plate in the brand colour with ink chosen by the engine
hills, ground, sun and steam are all tinted from the sky
film grain over the poster colours
long names put two letters on a wagon and shrink the train to fit
